description:
Add a decoy, subscribe to summaries, or test delivery. Each action needs owner approval (consent=true) and Watchtower write access (watch:manage).
• createCanary adds a link or token that alerts on use. Take target from monitors in the Watchtower overview, choose kind, and supply a fresh UUID as id. Reuse id on retry. Only the first response includes the secret. For a new site, start with vulkill_watchtower_register_target.
• weekly subscribes with enabled=true. A supplied timezone fills an unset preference. To change an existing time zone or unsubscribe, use vulkill_watchtower_control.
• testChannels takes only action and consent. It queues a real test on configured channels, once per minute per account.

action.description: Choose weekly to subscribe to summaries, createCanary to add a decoy, or testChannels to send a delivery test to the owner.

consent.description: True only after the account owner explicitly approves the specific change and its effects.

enabled.description: Required for weekly. Omit for canary creation and delivery tests.

id.description: Caller-generated UUID for the decoy. Required only for createCanary.

kind.description: For createCanary only. Choose link for a decoy URL or token for a synthetic credential.

target.description: For createCanary only. Use the owned, covered target UUID from the overview.

timezone.description: Optional weekly digest time zone. Use an IANA name such as Europe/Istanbul.

name: vulkill_watchtower_manage

alreadyCreated.description: The matching canary was already issued for this request UUID.

id.description: Identifier for the new canary or queued notification test.

ok.description: The request was accepted. A delivery test is queued and its arrival can be checked on the owner’s chosen channels.

oneTimeValueAvailable.description: The original canary value cannot be retrieved on retry.

value.description: New canary link or token. Returned only at creation. Treat it as a secret.

title: Add a canary, subscribe or test delivery
